-- 只读检查目标、停止现场和原生条件界面；不修改断点或运行状态。
local context = debug_getCurrentContextTable(false)
local list = nil
local conditionDialog = false
for index = 0, getFormCount() - 1 do
    local form = getForm(index)
    if form.ClassName == 'TfrmBreakpointlist' then
        assert(list == nil, 'Multiple breakpoint lists')
        list = form
    elseif form.ClassName == 'TfrmBreakpointCondition' then
        conditionDialog = true
    end
end
local view = list and list.findComponentByName('ListView1')
local refresh = list and list.findComponentByName('Timer1')
local menu = list and list.findComponentByName('miSetCondition')
local memory = getMemoryViewForm()
local add = getAddressSafe('victoria3.exe+11FD93B')
local remove = getAddressSafe('victoria3.exe+11FAF69')
local existing = {}
for _, address in ipairs(debug_getBreakpointList() or {}) do
    existing[#existing + 1] = string.format('%X', address)
end
local registers = {}
if type(context) == 'table' then
    for _, name in ipairs({'RIP','RSP','RCX','RDX','RBP','RBX','THREADID'}) do
        if math.type(context[name]) == 'integer' then registers[name] = string.format('%X', context[name]) end
    end
end
local storage = readQword(0x3A484D9F8E8 + 8)
return {
    pid=getOpenedProcessID(), target64Bit=targetIs64Bit(), debugging=debug_isDebugging(),
    stopped=type(context) == 'table', registers=registers,
    moduleBase=string.format('%X', getAddress('victoria3.exe')),
    addAddress=add and string.format('%X', add) or '',
    addInstruction=add and disassemble(add) or '',
    removeAddress=remove and string.format('%X', remove) or '',
    removeInstruction=remove and disassemble(remove) or '',
    existingBreakpoints=existing, conditionDialogOpen=conditionDialog,
    ui={breakpointList=list ~= nil, listView=view ~= nil,
        refreshEvent=refresh ~= nil and type(refresh.OnTimer) == 'function',
        conditionMenu=menu ~= nil,
        openListMenu=memory.findComponentByName('Breakpointlist1') ~= nil,
        timerApi=type(createTimer) == 'function', tickApi=type(getTickCount) == 'function'},
    historicalTableReadable=storage ~= nil,
    historicalStorage=storage and string.format('%X', storage) or '',
    tradeWatchExists=tradeWatch ~= nil,
}
